verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Box webhooks and an event feed, which notify external endpoints or subscribers when events happen. These are developer building blocks for constructing automation, not a documented rule engine where users define event-triggered actions. The one example of 'when a PDF lands, Box AI Extract pulls metadata' is a use-case illustration with no rule-definition mechanism described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
